# Order of Muleege Dynasty

|type=Order|house=|motto=|eligibility=|for=Service for the government or the Maldives|status=Currently constituted|head_title=|head=|grades=Collar|post-nominals=ODRMD|former_grades=|first_induction=|last_induction=|total=|higher=Order of Izzuddin|lower=|image2=|caption2=||day=|chancellor=|commander=|date=|individual=}}
The Order of the Dignified Rule of Muleege Dynasty, is the third highest national honour in the Maldives and the highest award that can be bestowed upon a civilian.
History
This award commemorates the rule of Sultan Muhammad Shamsuddeen III.
